partition.native_attachment_policy: unsupported fine cells promoted to their 2x2 parent tile and coalesced at its area-weighted centroid
partition.coalesced_pressure_limitation: Each coalesced parent tile reports one average pressure and cannot resolve partial opening or a local pressure peak within that tile.

pb03_contact_model.law: four equal-area centroid cells per face with common areal density

attempts.termination: Contact and PB01 axial active sets converged
